headline: SFG @ MIL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SFG 3.52 at MIL 4.51, with a projected total of 8.03. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SFG: SFG moved -0.04 runs while MIL moved -0.39, changing the projected margin by +0.35 runs. The projected total fell -0.44, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +19.1%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Shane Drohan has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jung Hoo Lee, Casey Schmitt, William Contreras, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Blake Perkins, Brice Turang because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
